title: 塞尔达化学引擎：三条规则，让世界自己算

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 1 期
scenes.title: 没人写过这个场面

lines.zh: 在塞尔达里，你点着一片草，火会顺着风烧过去，热气流还能把你托上天。
lines.en: In Zelda, light a patch of grass and the fire runs with the wind, and the hot air can carry you into the sky.

lines.zh: 你有没有想过，这是为什么？
lines.en: Have you ever wondered why?

lines.zh: 其实，没有人专门为这个场面写过一行剧本。
lines.en: In fact, nobody ever scripted this moment.

lines.zh: 它是三条规则自己算出来的。今天我们把它拆开，再亲手写一个能玩的版本。
lines.en: Three rules work it out on their own. Today we take it apart, then build a playable version ourselves.

scenes.title: 加法谜题 vs 乘法玩法

lines.zh: 老塞尔达的谜题是加法：每个火焰机关，都是为那一个房间单独做的。
lines.en: Classic Zelda puzzles were additive: every fire puzzle was built for one specific room.

lines.zh: 旷野之息想要乘法：只定少数几条规则，让它们互相相乘，玩法自己长出来。
lines.en: Breath of the Wild wanted multiplication: a few rules that multiply each other, so play grows by itself.

lines.zh: 怎么做到？二零一七年的游戏开发者大会上，技术总监给出了答案。
lines.en: How? At GDC 2017, the technical director gave the answer.

scenes.title: 物理算运动，化学算状态

lines.zh: 物理引擎负责东西怎么动，化学引擎负责东西变成什么状态。
lines.en: The physics engine decides how things move. The chemistry engine decides what state they are in.

lines.zh: 火、水、冰、电、风叫做元素；草、木头、金属叫做材料。
lines.en: Fire, water, ice, electricity and wind are elements. Grass, wood and metal are materials.

lines.zh: 规则一：元素能改变材料的状态。火让草燃烧，电让金属带电。
lines.en: Rule one: elements change the state of materials. Fire burns grass; electricity charges metal.

lines.zh: 规则二：元素能改变元素。水能浇灭火，火能融化冰。
lines.en: Rule two: elements change elements. Water puts out fire; fire melts ice.

lines.zh: 规则三，也是最反直觉的一条：材料不能改变材料。
lines.en: Rule three, and the least intuitive: materials cannot change materials.

lines.zh: 着火的木头，并不会直接点着隔壁的木头。
lines.en: A burning log does not light the log next to it directly.

lines.zh: 真正跨过去的，是它放出来的元素，也就是火。
lines.en: What crosses the gap is the element it gives off: fire.

lines.zh: 我们照着这个思路，把地面切成四十八乘四十八的小格。
lines.en: Following that idea, we cut the ground into a 48 by 48 grid.

lines.zh: 每一格只记几个数字：温度、湿度、燃料、冰，还有电荷。
lines.en: Each cell stores just a few numbers: temperature, moisture, fuel, ice and charge.

lines.zh: 你看到的火焰、水洼和电弧，都只是这些数字的画面。
lines.en: The flames, puddles and arcs you see are only pictures of those numbers.

lines.zh: 燃烧只有一个判断：够热、有燃料、又不太湿，它就烧起来。
lines.en: Burning is a single check: hot enough, has fuel, not too wet. Then it ignites.

lines.zh: 烧着的格子消耗燃料，把热量放给周围八个邻居。邻居变热，又接着烧。
lines.en: A burning cell eats its fuel and releases heat to its eight neighbours. They heat up and catch in turn.

lines.zh: 风只做一件事：让下风方向的邻居多分一点热。火线就自己歪了过去。
lines.en: Wind does just one thing: downwind neighbours get a little more heat. The fire front bends on its own.

lines.zh: 那怎么灭火？下一场雨。
lines.en: So how do you put it out? Make it rain.

lines.zh: 雨水抬高湿度、带走热量，燃烧的判断不再成立，火就自己熄了。
lines.en: Rain raises moisture and draws away heat. The burning check fails, and the fire dies by itself.

lines.zh: 我们从没写过雨天关掉火焰特效，改的只是数据。
lines.en: We never wrote 'hide the flames when it rains'. We only changed the data.

lines.zh: 再看飞行。把所有燃烧格的热量加起来，就是一股上升气流。
lines.en: Now flight. Add up the heat of every burning cell and you get an updraft.

lines.zh: 滑翔伞飞进气流，就会被托起来。火的输出，变成了移动的输入。
lines.en: A paraglider that enters the column gets lifted. Fire's output becomes movement's input.

lines.zh: 这就是乘法：火和滑翔，原本是两套毫不相干的系统。
lines.en: That is multiplication: fire and gliding were two unrelated systems.

lines.zh: 冰也一样。周围够热，冰就变少，融出来的水让地面变湿。
lines.en: Ice works the same way. With enough heat around, it shrinks, and the meltwater wets the ground.

lines.zh: 湿地和金属能导电。电荷沿着相邻的格子传过去，每走一步弱一点。
lines.en: Wet ground and metal conduct. Charge hops from cell to neighbouring cell, weaker with every step.

lines.zh: 现在把它们串起来：火融化冰，融水接通电路，远处的机关亮了。
lines.en: Now chain them: fire melts the ice, the meltwater closes the circuit, and the far switch lights up.

lines.zh: 这个解法我们一行都没写过，是规则自己算出来的。
lines.en: We never wrote this solution. The rules worked it out.

lines.zh: 想放进自己的游戏？记住三件事。
lines.en: Want this in your own game? Remember three things.

lines.zh: 第一，模拟和渲染分开。固定步长更新数据，画面只负责读。
lines.en: One: keep simulation and rendering apart. Update data on a fixed step; rendering only reads it.

lines.zh: 第二，规则只看材料属性，不看物体是谁，不要写火把碰到木箱这种特例。
lines.en: Two: rules look at properties, never at which object it is. No special cases like 'torch touches crate'.

lines.zh: 第三，先在小网格里把规则调稳，再搬进三维世界，用空间查询代替格子邻居。
lines.en: Three: tune the rules on a small grid first, then move to 3D, with spatial queries instead of grid neighbours.

lines.zh: 效果预览和全部源码都放在网页里了，点火、下雨、放电，你可以自己玩。
lines.en: The live preview and full source are on the web page. Light fires, make rain, send current. Try it yourself.

lines.zh: 同样一把火，有的游戏烧的是世界，有的游戏烧的是伤害。
lines.en: The same fire: some games burn the world, others burn damage.

lines.zh: 下一期，我们专门拆原神的元素反应。
lines.en: Next time, we take apart Genshin Impact's elemental reactions.

lines.zh: 如果这期对你有帮助，求一个一键三连，再点个关注。
lines.en: If this helped, please like, coin and favourite, and hit follow.

lines.zh: 让我薅点叔叔的羊毛，继续开发自己的游戏。我们下期见！
lines.en: Let me earn a little from Uncle Bilibili, so I can keep building my own game. See you next time!
